Founded in 1996, The Oil & Gas Conference® is the largest 
independent energy investment conference in the U.S.
The Oil & Gas Conference® offers 
investment professionals the 
opportunity to listen to the world’s 
key senior management teams, 
present their growth plans, and 
provides industry professionals a venue to learn about important energy 
topics effecting the global oil and gas industry. 
EnerCom’s The Oil & Gas Conference® routinely hosts over 2,000 
registrants and upwards of 100 company presentations whose operations 
span more than 40 countries and six continents. 
Founded in 2017, EnerCom Dallas™ is the evolution of EnerCom’s Q1 
conference held in San Francisco 14 years prior to moving to the Lone 
Star State.   
The EnerCom Dallas™ conference offers the 
opportunity for investment professionals to 
come together in one central location to listen 
to senior management teams update investors 
on their operational and financial strategies and learn how the leading energy 
companies are building value in 2020. 
TM
SAVE THE DATE:  FEBRUARY 11 – 12, 2020 
SAVE THE DATE:  AUGUST 16 – 19, 2020  

--- PAGE 3 ---
Network and connect with key decision makers who year after year make up an overwhelming 
majority of EnerCom conference registrants. Being an EnerCom Conference Sponsor gives 
you command of attention throughout the event and reinforces the trust EnerCom has in your 
brand, which positively influences perception among registrants identified below.   
Using EnerCom conference attendee data we’ve broken our audience down into three main 
groups: Sellside/Banking/Brokerages, Buyside Investors, and Industry Participants. Our 
audience of industry leaders and key decision makers provide you with a unique opportunity 
and venue to connect with potential clients and partners. 
Your sponsorship level will directly impact how Industry Participants engage with your brand. 
We offer various ways to taylor a sponsorhip to fit your needs and further the connections 
you are able to make with our audience. Targeted attendees will leave having made a one on 
one connection with your company and or digested a valuable determination of your offering; 
making them warm leads to approach thereafter. 
SPONSOR
LOCATION AND INDUSTRY BEHAVIOR 
EnerCom conferences are centralized in prime energy industry focused cities and are heavily 
integrated in Industry Participant’s yearly calendars. With over 50 energy industry events hosted 
to date, key players know they will be returning to EnerCom conferences each year to meet, 
connect, and learn from the best in the energy sector.

limitations: Official-domain hosting and matching phone/domain support the historical company/address association, not a present address update.
No UCC document number appears inside the brochure; the bridge combines exact name from the retained official site and the registry row with full historical company contact address from the brochure.
No 2019-12-12 publication date or precise address occupancy date is claimed from a 2020 brochure.
UCC active/lapse/termination fields are retained source reporting, not a judgment about current enforceability, loan balances, new financing or debt status.
The claimed minority/women-owned status on the website is not independently certification-verified.
The 1996 conference origin is not treated as the business legal formation date.
Seven complete PDF pages and two actual distinct source-reader receipts are retained; incidental small sponsor-logo text in the photograph is not identity evidence.
The two distinct 2019 UCC files are separate originals; the Greenwood Village SOS and 2017 UCC at 800 18th Street remain unresolved.
The sole PDF final HTTP response is represented as one terminal captured hop; the original receipt records zero redirects.
Historical event registrants and sponsorship prices do not establish employees, realized revenue or current purchasing power.
